command_contract.bind: first command only; binding payload; verifies exact parent-observed identity
command_contract.materialize: projection payload; R0 generation 0 once then R1 generation 1 once; anchor published last
command_contract.emit: null payload; exactly once at accepted R0; actual Actor interaction
command_contract.arm_fault: failure_case payload; once, only its exact F-row boundary; canonical faults remain Python-only
command_contract.operation_ids: bind_0001,materialize_0001,emit_0001,inspect_L0,inspect_L1,inspect_L2,inspect_L3,materialize_0002,inspect_L4,inspect_L5,arm_fault_0001,shutdown_0001; each at most once per domain except terminal failure ends remainder

descriptor_contract.transport: canonical JSON lines on stdin/stdout; UE log lines on stdout retained and parsed separately; stderr captured verbatim
descriptor_contract.extra_descriptor_rule: close all nonstandard inherited descriptors; audit before acceptance; refuse child helpers retaining proof pipes

plugin_contract.name: CityLiveEvidenceProof
plugin_contract.extra_plugins: only observed engine defaults and this declared plugin; record full loaded module identity; no undeclared proof-semantic input

artifact_record_contract.record.json: one closed output_fields object; raw Q bytes and old detached receipts stored losslessly as canonical UTF-8 strings in captured_evidence; missing capture is null with a failed case disposition, never a synthetic Q
artifact_record_contract.harness.jsonl: ordered append-only command, binding, liveness, head, disposition and fault events; each line has sequence, event_id, operation_id, domain, monotonic_ns, payload and previous_event_sha256; payload must match its declared command/response/fault schema
artifact_record_contract.stdout_stderr: verbatim bytes from named original process; replacement logs separate in F07; empty bytes do not prove liveness
artifact_record_contract.acquisition.json: enumerates exact case IDs and artifact paths/hash/size; source commit/tree and build receipt hash; all failures must have exact expected code and canonical bytes; schema city.live_evidence_acquisition.v1
artifact_record_contract.build.json: exact argv, cwd, source commit/tree, returncode, start/end timestamps, log hash, editor/project/module hashes and loaded executable inventory; compile success alone makes no live claim
